articles.description: Kevin Lamarque / REUTERS President Donald Trump is set to dismantle a cornerstone of his predecessor’s climate policy by repealing limits on greenhouse gas emissions from coal and gas plants. articles.title: Horoscope for Monday, September 14, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

After 2 a.m., there are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Scorpio.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

An average day

You'll be pleased at how much you accomplish today! This is because your ruler, Mars, is boosting the sun while it is traveling through your house of employment. You'll be the perfect example of Col. Saito's motto: "Be happy in your work!"

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

Your choice is wide open today. You can work in a productive way, or you can use this same driving energy to explore sports events, fun activities with kids, the arts, the entertainment world or the hospitality industry. Relations with partners are supportive.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

You have lots of energy to make home improvements today. You might also be more involved than usual with a parent. Meanwhile, relations with co-workers are wonderful! Accept someone's help. A work-related romance might be percolating.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

A positive day

Enjoy a short trip. Take care of appointments and errands. Explore your ability to sell, market, talk or teach because these are all excellent choices for you today. Oh yes — you're bright-eyed and bushy-tailed! You're active, confident and keen to express yourself. People will listen to you.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

An average day

You have strong moneymaking ideas and the energy to make money. You might do this in a public way or quietly behind the scenes. This is also an excellent day to entertain at home because relations with family members, especially females, are loving.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

A dynamic day

This is a positive day! The sun is in your sign getting a boost from fiery Mars, while the moon is lined up with Venus in your house of communications. You're in the right place, at the right time, saying the right thing to the right person. A winning day!

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A positive day

Today you might choose to play things low-key and work behind the scenes. Nevertheless, you'll accomplish a lot! With Mercury in your sign, you're keen to express your ideas to others. Meanwhile, shopping for beautiful things will appeal, especially checking out art, gorgeous fabrics, and clothes.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

A positive day

Today the moon is lined up with fair Venus in your sign, which is a winning combination! You're charming with everyone. This is why everyone wants to be in your company. (Your charisma will convince people to jump on your bandwagon.)

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

A positive day

You make a strong impression on everyone today because the sun is at the top of your chart, casting you in a flattering spotlight, while Mars amplifies this energy, making you virtually shine in the eyes of others. Use this to your advantage.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

A positive day

Grab every chance to travel today or do something to expand your horizons because you have a strong urge to do so. Enjoy learning through film, study or talking to people from different backgrounds. You'll also get a kick out of the stimulation of a new place — anything different. (Romance with a friend might begin.)

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

A positive day

Discussions about shared property, taxes, debt and insurance issues will be lively today. Because both the moon and Venus are lined up at the top of your chart, not only will you be high visibility, but these discussions are also very likely to go in your favor. And everyone will know it.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A positive day

You might attract someone today who is forthright and direct. Because another influence encourages romance with someone "different," this could signal some kind of attraction for you. However, it will also encourage fun socializing and physical activity.

If today is your birthday

Actor Sam Neill (1947-2026) shares your birthday today. You are steadfast, organized, efficient and energetic. You take charge quickly with a sharp eye. This is a year of service for you, perhaps service to family. Take care of yourself so that you can be a resource to those who turn to you for guidance, comfort and courage.

articles.title: Trump’s Childhood Home Sells After Mold and Cat Cleanup
articles.description: Google Maps Once overrun by feral cats and riddled with mold, President Donald Trump’s childhood home has sold for $1.93 million, following a $500,000 renovation. The five-bedroom Tudor-style house in Jamaica Estates, a Queens neighborhood in New York City, had fallen into disrepair by the time developer Tommy Lin bought it for $835,000 in 2025. A burst pipe left water damage, mold took hold, and a colony of feral cats moved in. Lin spent eight months renovating the property before listing it for $1.99 million. The broker managing the listing said “there were quite a lot of people” interested because of its presidential connection. Trump’s father, real estate developer Fred Trump, built the brick-and-stucco home in 1940. Trump lived there until age four, when his family moved to a larger house nearby. The property sold for $2.14 million in 2017 to a buyer who attempted to cash in on Trump’s first term. It became a Trump-themed Airbnb renting for $725 a night before falling into neglect. Even after its extensive makeover, the house fetched less than it did when Trump first took office. Read it at NY POST Read more at The Daily Beast.
